HKMA Launches Project SAGE and Establishes Expert Group for Agentic Finance
summary:
The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) announced today (2 November) the launch of Project SAGE to support the responsible development and adoption of agentic finance in Hong Kong.
As Agentic A.I. technologies continue to mature, the financial industry is moving beyond internal adoption to explore how A.I. agents may make financial services more efficient and secure.  This emerging paradigm, widely known as agentic finance, has the potential to transform customer engagement with financial services.  Meanwhile, the associated risks and challenges need to be properly addressed to support its responsible development and adoption.
Against this backdrop, the HKMA launched Project SAGE, which stands for “Securing Agentic Finance with Governance and Enablement”, to enable practical applications of agentic finance, while ensuring governance framework is in place.  Project SAGE will focus on four key areas:
Market Development and Use Case Exploration: Support industry participants and their partners in exploring and validating agentic finance use cases and solutions, while facilitating dialogue with the HKMA on practical implementation considerations and challenges. Potential areas of exploration include:

Business-to-consumer (B2C), such as agentic commerce and everyday payments;
Business-to-business (B2B), such as procurement and treasury management; and
Machine-to-machine (M2M), such as usage-based payments for digital services.
Agent Identity: Explore approaches to verifying A.I. agents’ identities and delegated authority, including Know Your Agent (KYA) practices and authentication mechanisms, to facilitate their trusted participation in financial activities;
Interoperability Standards: Facilitate industry discussion on interoperability-related topics, including relevant standards and protocols, to support secure and seamless interactions across the agentic finance ecosystem; and
Legal and Regulatory Frameworks: Exchange views on legal and regulatory considerations arising from agentic finance, including governance arrangement, liability, consumer protection.
To bring together relevant expertise and perspectives, the HKMA has established the Agentic Finance Expert Group to support the work of Project SAGE.  The group comprises relevant stakeholders including financial institutions, technology service providers, professional service firms and academia (see Annex for the list of members).
Mr Eddie Yue, Chief Executive of the HKMA, said, “Agentic finance has the potential to transform how financial services are delivered and utilised.  By introducing a series of initiatives and facilitating exchanges with industry experts, we aim to foster innovation while reinforcing Hong Kong’s leading role in next generation of financial technology.  These initiatives will help us navigate the opportunities and challenges ahead, ensuring that agentic finance serves the best interests of users while safeguarding the stability of our financial system.”

title: Texas Bank Has Signed a Definitive Agreement to Acquire Haskell National Bank
summary:
Texas Banc Financial Corp., the holding company of TexasBank, and Haskell Bancshares, Inc., the holding company of Haskell National Bank, today announced that they have entered into a definitive agreement under which Texas Banc Financial Corp. will acquire Haskell Bancshares, Inc. As part of the transaction, Haskell National Bank will merge into TexasBank.
The partnership reflects a shared commitment to relationship-driven banking, local decision-making, and continued investment in the communities both banks have served for generations.
The transaction is subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals and customary closing conditions and is expected to close later this year or early next year.
“This combination represents the best of community banking—strong local relationships, shared values, and a long-term commitment to the people and businesses we serve,” said Greg Dodds, President and CEO of TexasBank. “Haskell National Bank has built an exceptional legacy in West Texas, and we are honored to build on that foundation. Together, we will continue investing in these communities while expanding the resources and capabilities available to our customers.”
Haskell National Bank has long-served families, farmers, ranchers, and small businesses throughout the region, earning a reputation for trust, service, and leadership. TexasBank brings additional scale and resources, while maintaining a consistent focus on community banking.
“This is a partnership rooted in shared values and a common vision for the future,” said Robert Howard, CEO of Haskell National Bank. “TexasBank understands the importance of local relationships and community presence. We are confident this combination will preserve our legacy while creating new opportunities to serve our customers and support the growth of our communities.”
The combined organization will focus on preserving existing relationships, investing in the local economies across Haskell, Abilene, and the surrounding areas, and expanding financial solutions, treasury management, and digital banking capabilities to meet the evolving needs of customers.

Alibaba Brings Cloud and AI to the First Youth Olympic Games in Africa
summary:
In a historic milestone for African sport, Alibaba Group, in partnership with the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and the Dakar 2026 Organizing Committee, will power the Summer Youth Olympic Games Dakar 2026 (Dakar 2026) with its cloud and AI technology. As a Worldwide Olympic TOP Partner, Alibaba will optimise operations and elevate spectator engagement for Dakar 2026, and deliver a lasting digital legacy for Senegal.
Kirsty Coventry, President of the International Olympic Committee, said: “Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games are the first Olympic event taking place on African soil. I'm delighted that our Worldwide Olympic Partner, Alibaba, is helping bring this historic moment to life. Through its cloud and AI technology, Alibaba is helping the Games run more smoothly and bringing fans around the world closer to the action.”
Mamadou Diagna Ndiaye, President of the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games Organizing Committee (YOGOC), said: “We want Dakar 2026 to feel ambitious, welcoming and unmistakably Senegalese. The right technology will help us run the Games smoothly and give young athletes, visitors and audiences a connected experience from the moment they arrive. It will also leave us with stronger digital capabilities to support future events and public services.”
Toby Xu, Chief Financial Officer, Alibaba Group, said: “Sport is now a truly digital experience, and audiences expect more ways to follow and engage with the action. Cloud and AI capabilities are helping the industry respond by making services easier to scale and adapt. As a Worldwide Olympic Partner for nearly a decade, Alibaba has consistently helped drive the Olympic Movement forward-moving from digitalisation to intelligence through technological innovation. For Dakar 2026, we look forward to seeing how these technologies continue to shape the future of the Olympic Movement and beyond.”
Future-ready digital infrastructure to boost operational efficiency
The Dakar 2026 Organizing Committee will deploy a private cloud built on Alibaba Cloud's Apsara Stack for the Games' digital operations. Serving as the event’s digital backbone, this scalable and secure cloud platform will host applications and services such as ticketing and e-visa processing.
Running on this dedicated cloud infrastructure, the ticketing system built by Alibaba Cloud will handle online ticket sales and on-site access control for over one million tickets across all seven venues and the official Festival Site. The highly elastic infrastructure will ensure seamless performance during high-demand sales windows and peak entry periods.
Upon completion of the Games, the private cloud infrastructure will be handed over to Senegal to serve as a national cloud platform, supporting the country’s long-term digital transformation and leaving a lasting technological legacy.
After the Games, businesses and developers in Senegal can tap into Alibaba’s full-stack capabilities for AI innovation through this cloud platform and Alibaba's Qwen open-weight models. As one of the world’s most popular AI model families, Qwen boasts 460 open-weight models and over 3 billion global downloads. It supports over 200 languages worldwide, spanning diverse linguistic groups from Niger-Congo languages like Wolof and Kongo, to Indo-European languages such as French and Italian.
Fusing culture and AI at Dakar 2026
At the Opening Ceremony of Dakar 2026, the Organizing Committee unveiled an AI-powered celebration of drum performance created using Alibaba’s WAN video generation model. Centered around the iconic rhythm of the African drum, the one-minute video brought together 100 participants from the Dakar 2026 Learning Academy—representing youth from across Africa and around the world who embody the human legacy of the Games—virtually performing drum together.
The experience continues throughout the Games for athletes, spectators, media and the local community. Embracing Senegal’s spirit of Teranga, the Wolof concept of hospitality, Alibaba is utilising technology to foster openness, respect, and co-creation in the host city. At the official Festival Site, visitors can step into a kiosk hosted by Alibaba to generate a short video of themselves playing the Senegalese Sabar Drum. Additionally, an AI agent powered by Alibaba’s cloud-based AI technology answers questions about Dakar 2026 and the history of the Youth Olympic Games.
Community empowerment and youth development
Beyond technology infrastructure, Alibaba is collaborating with the Dakar 2026 Organizing Committee to drive local youth development initiatives alongside the Games. Alibaba Philanthropy has expanded its Panda Pack Project to Senegal, providing sports equipment packages to the Jeunesse en Jeux engagement program. Aiming to reach over 350,000 children across 850 schools, this initiative reinforces the long-term legacy of Dakar 2026 by promoting sports accessibility in local communities.
In addition, the Alibaba Cloud Tech Academy provides free online cloud computing training for Senegalese youth under 35, already drawing over 10,000 registrations.
The Summer Youth Olympic Games Dakar 2026 is taking place in Senegal from 31 October to 13 November 2026 across Dakar, Diamniadio and Saly. The event brings together 2,700 athletes aged 17 or under to compete across 35 sports.
Alibaba’s contribution to Dakar 2026 builds on its proven track record as a Worldwide Olympic Partner at Tokyo 2020, Beijing 2022, Paris 2024, and Milano Cortina 2026. This experience will support reliable event delivery while creating meaningful digital value for Senegal.

content: Supermarket refrigeration units across Europe have been compromised in a cyberattack. The hacked fridges are reportedly being forced into defrost mode, which threatens to cause millions of euros in financial damages due to spoiled goods. Security experts are monitoring the situation as investigations into the breach continue.
content_ta: ஐரோப்பாவில் உள்ள பல்பொருள் அங்காடிகளின் குளசாதனப் பெட்டிகள் இணையத் தாக்குதலுக்கு உள்ளாகியுள்ளன. ஹேக் செய்யப்பட்ட இந்த குளசாதனப் பெட்டிகள் தானாகவே டிஃப்ராஸ்ட் (defrost) முறைக்கு மாற்றப்படுவதால், உணவுப் பொருட்கள் பழுதடைந்து மில்லியன் கணக்கில் யூரோ மதிப்பிலான நஷ்டம் ஏற்படும் என அஞ்சப்படுகிறது. இந்த பாதுகாப்பு மீறல் குறித்து வல்லுநர்கள் விசாரணை நடத்தி வருகின்றனர்.

content: Bitcoin is facing a critical test near the $78,000 level amid market volatility. The cryptocurrency recently dropped to lows around $76,460 following a reported security breach at Binance, creating fresh uncertainty. Analysts are watching to see if market conditions could trigger a short squeeze and push prices toward $85,000, though sustaining upward momentum remains a challenge.
content_ta: மார்க்கெட் நிலவரங்களில் நிலவும் ஏற்றத்தாழ்வுகளால் Bitcoin தனது விலையில் முக்கியமான சோதனையை எதிர்கொண்டுள்ளது. Binance-ல் ஏற்பட்ட பாதுகாப்பு மீறல் தொடர்பான செய்திகளைத் தொடர்ந்து, கிரிப்டோகரன்சி சமீபத்தில் $76,460 வரை சரிந்தது. இது சந்தையில் புதிய நிச்சயமற்ற தன்மையை உருவாக்கியுள்ளது. விலையானது மீண்டும் $85,000 நோக்கி உயர வாய்ப்புள்ளதா என்பதை ஆய்வாளர்கள் கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.
